label: Whatever is GOD_4 is maximal in BEING_2, from primary of BEING_2
meaning: A second derivation of STMT-GOD-IS-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING (after GOD-MAXIMAL-FROM-CAUSING), through the measure of q.3 a.5 ad 2 rather than causing: whatever is God is the primary of the order of being by approach (OPEN reading, supported by the q.3 a.5 ad 2 claim), and on that order with strict primacy the primary is maximal in being.
